newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Treasury offers A$1.0 bln of notes.
newsitem.headline: Australian Treasury offers A$1.0 bln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$1.0 billion of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$700 million of 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes.
There was no note tender last week, but the previous week saw the Treasury offer a total of A$1.2 billion of notes, comprising A$600 million of five-week and A$600 million of 13-week notes.
There are A$706 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending July 10.
